accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
aria: aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
errorMessage: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in checkbox.focus-ring.color.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while checked, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state, disabled is not submitted.

keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)
keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the checkbox

accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.
accessibility.targetSize: Box is 16px; the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.

antiPatterns.pattern: A checkbox that applies its effect immediately
antiPatterns.why: Checkboxes record a choice; a setting that acts at once reads as a switch

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several

antiPatterns.alternative: A label that states the choice
antiPatterns.why: The label is the only name for the box

useCases.when: An independent yes/no choice, or choosing several from a list
A parent row summarizes some-but-not-all children

useCases.use: required with a label that states the agreement
useCases.when: Agreement must be given before submit

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: box in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Box wrapper; positions the check and dash icons over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG checkbox pattern, label row beside the box.
openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?

openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked); selected is a property and attribute both read it at start.
openQuestions.question: Is selected reflected to an attribute?

openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.
openQuestions.question: Is label required?

errorMessage.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the box.

indeterminate.note: Mixed state (dash). Cleared by the first user toggle. Not reflected.

label.note: Visible label next to the box and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

required.note: Native required: must be checked. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

selected.note: Current state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

value.note: Submitted with the form while checked.

error.trigger: error-message set, or required and unchecked after blur or a submit attempt

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

indeterminate.note: Same fill as checked, dash instead of check.

contract.summary: A checkbox with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

# Plan: Checkbox (planning gate)

Status: Approved under SB-0011 (owner pre-approval, 2026-11-08).

## Scope
`sb-checkbox`: native checkbox in the shadow root with the Field horizontal layout (box, label, description, error). Form-associated. checked, indeterminate, disabled, required, value, error.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/checkbox/Checkbox.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/checkbox/checkbox.behavior.spec.ts` (first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/checkbox/Checkbox.scss` -> `Checkbox.styles.ts` |
| 4 | `src/components/checkbox/Checkbox.ts`, `index.ts` |

## Test plan
Name and label click, Space toggles, indeterminate (mixed, cleared on toggle), required/error validity, input and change composed, focus ring, form value (only while checked, custom value), reset to the attribute default, disabled, disabled fieldset, label for, axe.

## Accessibility deviations
- From the visual reference: border 3:1, solid focus ring.

## Open questions (recommendation first)
- Is `selected` reflected? No: the attribute stays the reset default.
- Semantic token added: `radius.xsmall` (4px in the default brand), aliasing the foundation `radius.xs` so it follows radius.style.
